headline: Nifty rose as *DIIs absorbed FII selling*
subline: Broad buying lifted 1,639 stocks. Fear still ticked up.
hero_text: FIIs sold Rs 1,462.49 Cr in cash. DIIs bought Rs 2,609.57 Cr and more than covered it.

why.title: Pharma led the large caps
why.desc: Dr Reddys jumped 6.62% and pulled the sector up.

why.title: Metals ran on steel strength
why.desc: JSW Steel rose 6.28% as the metal index led all sectors.

why.title: Fear edged up despite gains
why.desc: India VIX closed at its highest level in 20 sessions.

sector_reasons.Metal: Led the session on JSW Steel's jump
sector_reasons.Healthcare: Rode the Dr Reddys and pharma bid
sector_reasons.Pharma: Dr Reddys anchored a firm bid
sector_reasons.Media: Slipped while the wider tape rose
sector_reasons.Consumer Durables: Gave back ground against a rising tape
sector_reasons.Bank: Barely moved as HDFC Bank slipped

bonus_text: 1,639 stocks rose and 1,045 fell. Inside the Nifty 50, 37 names advanced and 13 declined.
movers_note_gainers: Dr Reddys and JSW Steel led, both up over 6%.
movers_note_losers: Three of the four losers were financial names, led by Shriram Finance.
watch_text: Tuesday is weekly expiry day. Nifty open interest sits between 22,500 puts and 23,000 calls.
lessons: Fear and gains coexisted. The VIX held its 20 session high while the index rose.
Foreign selling met domestic buying. DIIs absorbed more than FIIs sold.
A good day followed a weak week. Smallcaps rose but sat 6.05% lower over five days.
Banks barely moved while metals and pharma ran. Sector weight shaped the index gain.
alert_text: The Nifty weekly expiry falls on Tuesday. US CB Consumer Confidence prints at 23:30 IST.
cta_headline: A broad up day. *Expiry comes next*.
cta_sub: The Tuesday bell brings weekly expiry. Wrap lands after the close.
next_text: Tuesday 27 October brings the Nifty weekly expiry. US consumer confidence follows at 23:30 IST.
caption_a:
Nifty rose 0.68% to 22,753 even as FIIs sold Rs 1,462.49 Cr. DIIs bought Rs 2,609.57 Cr.

Breadth ran 1,639 up to 1,045 down. Metal gained 2.21%, Pharma 1.76%.

Watch: Nifty weekly expiry on Tuesday, with open interest between 22,500 and 23,000.
